title: Best Working Asset Generator?
author: Beginning-Sign1916
selftext: So I have done up quite an amount of research on assets generation and on the market there are so much right now. Tripo3D and Meshy are always one of the top recommended so if anyone is using it will really help me out if you can share your experiences and grade on the tools. I have come across this YouTube using free tools like ComfyUI and 3DGenstudio which I don’t mind learning along the way to generate out my characters and environments. I wanted to fully utilize my time without having to go back and forth with a tool just to generate out some assets.

comments.author: jtabernik
comments.body: I have been using TRELLIS.2 and it is pretty good!  The setup took a little work, but Claude was able to get me over every hurdle.  TRELLIS is interesting because instead of running in ComfyUI it runs as a standalone app that you run in your browser.  Worth a try I think!  And the quality is quite good.

replies.author: Beginning-Sign1916
replies.body: Yeah I am also using that as well. I was able to get some good 3D mesh assets for my three.js project next I am going to try it for my Unity and Unreal projects
